study type: Retrospective cohort study with nested case-control
cohort: 941 women who underwent cervical ripening and labor induction, with 167 women who had a cesarean section and 148 who had a vaginal delivery included in a nested case-control analysis
finding: A prediction model incorporating nulliparity, maternal height, maternal BMI, scarred uterus, and Bishop score had an area under the curve of 0.86 (0.82–0.90) for predicting cesarean section risk.
